div.div: صَرِيبٌ Milk that has been made what is termed صَرْب; as also ↓ مَصْرُوبٌ : (M, TA:) or sour milk: (A, K, TA:) pl. صُرْبٌ. (K.) So in the saying الضَّرِيبَ لَا الصَّرِيبَ, i. e. [Give me] the thick [milk], from a number of milch camels, that has been mixed together; not the sour. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
